create_parser_instance: create a Parser instance to manage multiple argparse sub-parsers for CLI argument parsing
add_parser_method: add a named argparse sub-parser to the Parser using add_parser with a name and parser object
parse_args_method: parse sys.argv through all registered sub-parsers and return a dictionary of parsed arguments
log_parsers_method: log all registered arg_parsers to stdout for debugging the Parser configuration
review_parser_class: review the Parser class that wraps multiple argparse sub-parsers with parse_known_args support
